routed.text: Carried from Q-027 (from S09, itself carried from Q-013, from S04), which matched S13 by its node and was closed there as explained, unaddressed, because a citation touch changes only citations (DEC-119). Original text: ADR-002 for the backend's plan: start and end as timestamptz with the half-open overlap rule; an exclusion constraint on tstzrange(start_at, end_at, '[)') with btree_gist is one way to hold AC-5.4, but its 23P01 DETAIL names one row, so the AC-5.3 body needs a re-read (hsdd/auto/experiments/time-model-postgres/); no zone arithmetic in the service; the quarter-hour check on the UTC instant; the injected clock decides started and ended (start equal to now is started); the account data gains timeZone; the gate's tests run with TZ set to a zone that is neither account's nor UTC.

Carried from Q-028 (from S09, itself carried from Q-017, from S05), which matched S13 by its node and was closed there as explained, unaddressed, because a citation touch changes only citations (DEC-119). Original text: booking-api@v1's fixtures (hsdd/contract/fixture/booking-api/, 35, all replay exact) add two fields the current rig (backend/test/replay.ts) cannot replay: clock, the instant the injected clock reads for the whole fixture, tokens included ({{expired-token:u}} is a token whose expiresAt is before clock); and given, bookings to create before the request, directly and with the fixture's UUIDs (some lie before the clock, which POST refuses), starting each fixture from no bookings. The rig also meets DELETE, and a 204 whose fixture body is null while the real response has no body (res.json() throws on an empty body), and a 201 whose id is checked against the schema and must differ from every given id. Each fixture's response validates against the top-level schema; $defs.GetRoomsResponse, GetMyBookingsResponse, PostBookingResponse and DeleteBookingResponse are per endpoint. Booking ids are lower-case UUIDs (gen_random_uuid in PostgreSQL 17), never reused.

Carried from Q-029 (from S09, itself carried from Q-018, from S05), which matched S13 by its node and was closed there as explained, unaddressed, because a citation touch changes only citations (DEC-119). Original text: booking-api@v1 for the backend's plan: G6 needs a re-read after an exclusion refusal (23P01 DETAIL names one row): the room's overlapping bookings ordered by start, the first one; if none remains because it was cancelled meanwhile, try the insert again, never a 409 without error.conflict and never a 5xx from contention (G5; PRD v2 Success, 20 simultaneous attempts). G1: accept an instant only when new Date(s).toISOString() === s; query values percent-decoded. The limits are instant arithmetic: end - start <= 8 h (G9), start - now <= 8,760 h (G10), started when now >= start (G7). The title counts code points (Ajv's maxLength does, JavaScript's .length does not), needs one non-whitespace character and is stored as sent (G8). The check orders of POST and DELETE are part of the contract (G15); a DELETE id that is not a UUID answers 404. Rooms come back in PRD v2 Rooms' order with ids merapi, bromo, thames, kew; lists sort by start, ties by that order (G13, G14). produced_by is the provisional guess simple-login.backend.4 (DEC-053).
